Synthetic DjVu fixture generated for Incremento tests; no user documents.

`text_and_blank.djvu` is a bundled three-page, 600×800 pixel document at
300 DPI. Pages 1 and 3 have no text. Page 2 has two positioned text words,
`Hello` and `κόσμος中文`, including Latin, Greek and Chinese characters.
Images are synthetic PBM bitmaps encoded with DjVuLibre's cjb2; djvused
added the text layer and djvm bundled the pages. Incremento's license applies.
